Lock their mana with Rishadan Port + Wasteland, protect creatures with Mother of Runes, and suit up a threat with Stoneforge Mystic -> Batterskull/Jitte. Swords to Plowshares removes their threats. Attrition and mana-denial win; don't race combo, disrupt it.
